greeting.title: Hello, I'm Samir — Full-Stack RFID & IoT Traceability Expert
greeting.subTitle: I design end-to-end, multi-vendor traceability solutions powered by UHF/RAIN RFID tags, BLE beacons, and GPS/IoT trackers. I integrate ecosystems from Impinj (R720, R700, Speedway R420/R220, and xSpan), Zebra (RFD90 including RFD9030/RFD9090, RFD40, RFD8500, FXR90, FX9600, and FX7500), and Digital Matter (Manta Fusion, Dart3 BLE, Oyster3, Remora3, Yabby3, and G150), among other brands selected to meet each project's needs. I cover the complete technical stack: hardware and edge/CAP, iOS and Android applications, databases, APIs, back-end, front-end, cloud services, and real-time indoor/outdoor mapping.

expertise.title: From tag to cloud: end-to-end, multi-vendor traceability
expertise.intro: As a full-stack RFID and IoT traceability expert, I turn tag reads and tracker positions into reliable, actionable business data. My expertise spans hardware, edge/CAP services, mobile applications, databases, APIs, back-end, front-end, cloud, and real-time visualization.
expertise.badgeAria: Under five years of professional experience
expertise.technologies: Integrated brands, models, tags, and technologies

rfid.title: Multi-vendor expertise tailored to every field environment
rfid.summary: Impinj, Zebra, and Digital Matter are some of the brands I integrate, alongside other manufacturers. I select, configure, and connect the tags, readers, and trackers best suited to each business and operational requirement.
rfid.capability1: UHF/RAIN RFID and BLE tag traceability: identification, encoding, tag-to-asset association, inventory, location, and movement history.
rfid.capability2: Impinj ecosystem: R720, R700, Speedway R420/R220, xSpan, and xArray, including specialized CAP applications and edge services.
rfid.capability3: Zebra ecosystem: RFD90 series (RFD9030/RFD9090), RFD40, RFD8500, FXR90, FX9600, and FX7500, integrated with mobile applications and business workflows.
rfid.capability4: Digital Matter ecosystem: Manta Fusion, Dart3 BLE, Oyster3, Remora3, Yabby3, and G150 for telemetry, GPS, BLE, and asset tracking.
rfid.imageAlt: Traceability ecosystem with fixed RFID readers, a handheld reader, and IoT tracking devices in a warehouse

mobile.title: RFID applications tailored to iOS and Android
mobile.summary: I build iOS and Android applications that communicate with readers, tags, and trackers, then synchronize data with APIs, databases, and back-end platforms.
mobile.capability1: Multi-vendor reader and accessory connectivity through SDKs, APIs, and Bluetooth, with clear device-state management.
mobile.capability2: Inventory, tag-to-asset association, item finding, validation, and correction workflows.
mobile.capability3: Resilient field operation with local queues and synchronization when connectivity returns.
mobile.capability4: A consistent iOS and Android experience with read feedback, diagnostics, and explicit error handling.
mobile.imageAlt: iOS phone, rugged Android terminal, and handheld RFID reader used to track packages

realtime.title: Real-time traceability, indoors and outdoors
realtime.summary: I bring indoor RFID events and outdoor GPS/IoT positions together in a full-stack platform connecting hardware, edge, back-end services, databases, front-end interfaces, and live maps.
realtime.capability1: Live maps with positions, movement, last-seen information, and the status of every asset or device.
realtime.capability2: A seamless transition between indoor floor plans, logistics sites, and outdoor tracking while retaining asset context.
realtime.capability3: Search, filters, history, geofences, and alerts that support faster operational decisions.
realtime.capability4: A complete architecture spanning hardware and edge services through APIs, databases, front-end interfaces, and real-time dashboards.
realtime.imageAlt: Live map connecting a warehouse, vehicles, geofences, and an asset-monitoring dashboard
